nuxtSiteConfig.description: A browser-based editor to make, print and export foldable A4 zines.

app.description: A browser-based editor to design the eight panels of a foldable A4 zine and export it as a print-ready PDF.

seo.title: Make and print an A4 zine
seo.description: Fanzines is an editor for laying out a foldable zine on a single A4 sheet: add text and images, then export it as a PDF.
seo.socialDescription: A simple editor to design, preview, print and fold your own zine.
seo.imageAlt: A folded zine and the editing tools in Fanzines

hero.title:
One sheet.
Eight pages.
Your zine.
hero.lede: Design each panel in your browser and download a PDF that is already imposed. Print, cut one line, fold. Ready to hand out in 10 minutes.
hero.foldedAlt: An unfolded zine on a table
hero.handAlt: A small zine held open in one hand

how.title:
From the browser
to the table.
how.intro: No working out the page order. The editor lays out the sheet for you.
how.sheetLabel: A4 sheet · it prints like this
how.sheetAlt: A4 sheet: on top, pages 6, 5, 4 and 3 upside down; below, back cover, front cover, 1 and 2.
how.sheetNote: the top row prints upside down · cut only the center line

design.title: Design each panel
design.text: Upload photos, write, and move, rotate or scale each piece right on the page.

download.title: Download the PDF
download.text: All eight pages come out in order on a landscape A4 sheet, with cut and fold guides.

print.title: Print, cut, fold
print.text: A home printer is enough. In two minutes you have a zine to give away or sell.

feature.title:
Design on screen.
Finish with paper
and scissors.
feature.intro: All eight pages in view, measurements in millimeters and a sheet review before you download.
feature.shotAlt: The Fanzines editor: the eight pages as thumbnails on the left, the front cover on the canvas and the options of the selected image on the right

need.question: What do I need?
need.answer: An A4 printer (yours at home or the one at the copy shop), a pair of scissors and a sheet of paper. That's it.

account.question: Do I have to create an account?
account.answer: No. Open the editor and start designing.

blackAndWhite.question: Can I print it in black and white?
blackAndWhite.answer: Yes. The PDF prints just as well in color or in black and white, the way zines always have.

fold.question: How do I fold it?
fold.answer: The PDF comes with cut and fold guides. Fold it lengthwise, cut the center line and close it like a book.

cta.title:
Start with a cover
and one image.
cta.note: It takes less time than a trip to the copy shop.
cta.photoAlt: A worktable with printed photos, a craft knife, a ruler and scissors

seo.title: A4 zine editor
seo.description: Design an eight-panel zine in your browser, check the A4 sheet and export a PDF that is ready to print and fold.
seo.imageAlt: The Fanzines editor with an A4 sheet and zine panels
